product_one_liner.value: Smallest.ai provides low-latency voice AI models and voice-agent tools for enterprises automating support, sales, collections, and scheduling.

pricing_page.notes: A public model pricing page is available.

named_customers.notes: Both are presented in Smallest AI customer stories.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn’s company data reports 104 employees, which falls in the 101–200 band.

founded_year.notes: Smallest AI’s CEO profile says he started the company in 2023.

eng_blog.notes: The blog has technical material, but the evidence reviewed establishes only one build-focused post clearly authored by an engineer; it does not establish the required two engineer-authored posts.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site includes product guides, model material, and API reference.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company job board has a Speech Research Scientist posting.

model_provider.value: Smallest AI’s in-house Electron model; the agent model selector also lists OpenAI models including GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT Realtime, and GPT Realtime Mini.

compliance_certs.notes: The product FAQ limits its HIPAA compliance statement to enterprise accounts.

last_funding.notes: The August 5, 2026 announcement says the company raised a $13 million Series A, bringing total funding above $21 million; date is the announcement month.

raised_18mo.notes: The announced Series A was in August 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Business Development Representative (BDR) posting is listed as recently posted.

launched_6mo.notes: Lightning V3 was introduced on October 5, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The November 6, 2026 announcement appoints Siddharth Sharma President of BFSI, India; the exact title is President, not explicitly C-level or VP.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR job listing names Zoho as its CRM.
